title: ETS Edge Hardware Qualification Profile v1
purpose: Define the bounded physical qualification cases required to evaluate a named ETS Edge device/revision/build without treating historical implementation checklists as qualification evidence.

capability_boundary.claim_statement: Qualification is bounded to the exact Edge DUT, hardware revision, firmware/security-element posture, immutable software build/configuration, environment, retained evidence, and independent verifier result recorded by the HQP run.

device_constraints.notes: A result for one Edge device or revision never qualifies another revision by implication. Claim-critical firmware/security-element values are carried in the HQP device firmware map and requalification is required when they change.

test_cases.title: Build identity and provenance are reproducible and retained
test_cases.purpose: Bind the DUT to an immutable software/configuration identity and retain build/SBOM/provenance material used by the qualification run.
pass_criteria: The installed commit/artifact/configuration digests are retained and unambiguous.
Required SBOM/provenance material is retained or an explicit bounded deviation is recorded.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Read-only collection only; never expose signing keys, bootstrap secrets, or credentials in retained build evidence.

test_cases.title: Device identity, enrollment, and key custody remain bounded
test_cases.purpose: Prove stable device identity and enrollment while demonstrating declared signer/key custody and non-disclosure of reusable bootstrap material.
pass_criteria: The device identity remains stable across the bounded enrollment/restart sequence.
Key custody matches the declared signer profile.
No reusable bootstrap secret is present in retained evidence/logs.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use synthetic enrollment material where possible; redact secrets before retention and never export private key bytes.

test_cases.title: Boot and storage security posture matches the declared target
test_cases.purpose: Measure Secure Boot, encrypted/sealed storage, rollback-protection, and signer posture without treating their presence as a general security certification.
pass_criteria: Observed security posture matches the target manifest and claim scope.
Any absent optional control is represented as a deviation/limitation rather than silently assumed.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Do not change firmware security state merely to execute this case; posture transitions require a separately approved recovery plan.

test_cases.title: Acknowledged committed evidence survives restart
test_cases.purpose: Prove that an acknowledged committed record remains recoverable and independently provable after a bounded process/host restart.
pass_criteria: No acknowledged committed record is lost.
Recovered identifiers/digests match retained pre-restart evidence.
The post-restart proof is independently verifiable.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Preserve storage and collect pre-stimulus state before restart; do not escalate to destructive repair during the test.

test_cases.title: Abrupt power interruption preserves committed evidence or fails explicitly
test_cases.purpose: Exercise bounded physical power loss and recovery to measure durable commit semantics and recovery diagnostics.
pass_criteria: Acknowledged committed records survive the approved abrupt power interruption.
Recovery state is explicit and contains no silent evidence loss.
Retained proof/checkpoint material remains independently verifiable.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use an approved switched-power lab harness and recovery image/backup; never perform this case on an uncontrolled production device.

test_cases.title: Disk watermark and exhaustion behavior fails boundedly
test_cases.purpose: Prove that storage pressure produces explicit degraded/backpressure behavior rather than silent loss after authoritative acknowledgement.
pass_criteria: Configured high/critical thresholds are observable.
Ingress/sync applies documented backpressure or rejection before unsafe acknowledgement.
Normal operation can be restored without rewriting evidence history.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Fill only a dedicated qualification volume or bounded filesystem allocation; preserve recovery headroom and never exhaust the host root filesystem unintentionally.

test_cases.title: Bounded queue saturation produces explicit backpressure
test_cases.purpose: Prove queue item/byte limits and deterministic backpressure without silent drop or unbounded pending-state growth.
pass_criteria: Queue limits are enforced by item/byte policy.
Saturation produces explicit backpressure/rejection.
Previously accepted records remain present and recoverable.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use synthetic records and bounded configured limits so the test cannot consume uncontrolled storage or memory.

test_cases.title: Local capture and proof remain available while upstream is offline
test_cases.purpose: Demonstrate the Edge local evidence boundary without a cloud dependency.
pass_criteria: Representative evidence can be committed while upstream is unavailable.
A local proof/export is available without upstream trust.
Pending synchronization remains bounded and explicit.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use a controlled network/upstream boundary; do not disrupt unrelated infrastructure.

test_cases.title: Partitioned synchronization resumes idempotently
test_cases.purpose: Exercise interrupted synchronization and prove resumability, duplicate resistance, and checkpoint agreement after reconnect.
pass_criteria: Interruption does not rewrite local sequence history.
Reconnect resumes without unintended logical duplication.
Local and upstream checkpoint/proof state can be independently compared.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Partition only the dedicated qualification path and retain independent network-observer timestamps.

test_cases.title: Checkpoint and proof continuity survive bounded disruption
test_cases.purpose: Prove inclusion/checkpoint continuity across restart, reconnect, and export boundaries.
pass_criteria: Pre-existing evidence remains provable after bounded disruption.
Checkpoint progression is independently consistent with retained evidence.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Read-only verification after the selected disruption; never repair or rewrite log history to force continuity.

test_cases.title: Clock degradation and rollback are explicit
test_cases.purpose: Measure time-quality behavior so wall-clock faults cannot silently rewrite sequence/evidence interpretation.
pass_criteria: Clock degradation/rollback is visible in retained diagnostics or metadata.
Monotonic evidence ordering is not silently rewritten by wall-clock change.
Time uncertainty is retained for interpretation.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use an isolated test time source or namespace/VM where possible; do not alter enterprise time infrastructure.

test_cases.title: Signer key unavailability and rotation fail closed
test_cases.purpose: Exercise signer loss/unavailability and approved rotation while preserving prior verification and explicit custody history.
pass_criteria: Unavailable signing authority does not silently fall back to an undeclared signer.
Rotation produces explicit identity/custody transition evidence.
Previously signed checkpoints remain verifiable with retained historical key material.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use dedicated qualification keys/security elements and documented recovery; never destroy sole production keys.

test_cases.title: Storage corruption or tamper is detected and bounded
test_cases.purpose: Prove that selected metadata/proof/checkpoint corruption produces explicit integrity failure rather than silent acceptance.
pass_criteria: The controlled mutation is detected by an applicable integrity/proof check.
Affected evidence is not reported as verified.
Diagnostic output identifies the bounded failure without asserting real-world cause.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Operate on a cloned qualification store and preserve the pristine source image before mutation.

test_cases.title: Update failure and rollback recover without committed evidence loss
test_cases.purpose: Exercise signed update/rollback/recovery behavior and downgrade protection for the declared appliance profile.
pass_criteria: A failed update can return to a declared known-good runtime or explicit failed state.
Committed evidence remains independently verifiable after recovery.
Downgrade acceptance/rejection matches the declared policy.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use staged qualification images and tested recovery media; never test destructive update failure without a restore path.

test_cases.title: Backup and restore reproduce retained evidence state
test_cases.purpose: Prove bounded backup/restore behavior without converting backup success into a broader disaster-recovery claim.
pass_criteria: Restored record/proof identities match retained pre-backup evidence for the selected scope.
Independent verification succeeds for restored proof material.
Excluded state and recovery-point limitations are explicitly recorded.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Restore to an isolated qualification target or clean volume; preserve the original source until verification completes.

test_cases.title: Capacity and soak limits are measured rather than assumed
test_cases.purpose: Measure sustained event/proof/sync/storage behavior and publish the bounded tested envelope for the named DUT.
pass_criteria: The exact workload duration/rate and environment are retained.
No unexplained acknowledged evidence loss or checkpoint divergence occurs within the tested envelope.
Observed limits are published as measurements, not universal promises.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Bound workload duration/rate and monitor temperature/storage endurance; stop on hardware safety or data-integrity threshold breach.

test_cases.title: Operator can trace source to proof/export and verify away from the DUT
test_cases.purpose: Exercise the local-first evidence workflow and demonstrate independent verification without trusting the Edge runtime narrative.
pass_criteria: The operator can trace one representative record from source/capture through event, tree head, inclusion proof, and export.
The exported material verifies in an independent environment.
Viewer/operator boundaries do not silently authorize trust-changing administration.
test_cases.safety_boundary: Use synthetic/non-sensitive evidence and a dedicated external verifier environment; do not retain credentials in exports.
